source: AI after causal reconstruction found 2032/2034 support labels; code tests unordered extrema rather than an actual current-day retest. No subgroup returns read before rule freeze.
change: Within the frozen detector's selected scale, require a post-right-rim high at or above its existing pivot on a market date strictly before the signal day; require today's low <= existing left-rim*1.01 and today's close >= left rim. This replaces the historical-anywhere support label with a current-day retest after an earlier breakout. Existing tolerances unchanged; no prior-close/pivot-cross condition.
scope: Strict subset of original executable events; no delayed or newly generated signals. Evaluate every original thin-book fill, retain original independent T+1 execution and exits. Excluded signals cannot affect other fills because there are no position constraints.
training: 2016-2022 only, causal detection ending on each signal date
initial_gate: At least 100 kept fills, positive mean net strictly above baseline, signal-day equal-weight actual net not worse and at least baseline count of positive years. Passing is research candidate only; further validation needed.
failure: Stop this current-day ordered-retest representation and its tolerance/window neighbours. Do not change VCP or product.
